metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in Shanghai above 39 degrees Celsius on August 7, 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS LST products (MOD11A1 or MYD11A1) for land surface temperature - Date: August 7, 2013 (single day) - Location: Shanghai, China (approximately 31.2°N, 121.5°E) 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST products have QA bands to filter out poor quality pixels - Need to apply QA mask to ensure valid temperature readings - No cloud masking needed as LST products already handle this 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02 scale factor - Valid temperature range: ~250-350K (approximately -23 to 77°C) - If max temperature is None or outside valid range → C3 - If max temperature > 312.15K (39°C) → A (Yes) - Otherwise → B (No) - Check pixel count to detect C2 (no valid pixels after QA filtering) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.4737, 31.2304]); const date = '2013-08-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Try MOD11A1 (Terra) first let col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(shanghai); let colSize = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MOD11A1 images found: ${colSize}`); // If no Terra data, try MYD11A1 (Aqua) if (colSize === 0) { col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD11A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(shanghai); colSize = await col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MYD11A1 images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS LST data available for this date."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing - Apply QA mask and get LST const img = col.first(); // Apply QA mask (mandatory QA flags - bits 0-1 should be 00 for good quality) const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); const mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km') .updateMask(mask) .multiply(0.02); // Scale factor to get Kelvin // 4. Check pixel count const countResult = await lst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount = countResult.LST_Day_1km || 0; console.log(`Valid pixels after QA masking: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality filtering."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Calculation - Get max temperature in the area const stats = await lst.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: shanghai.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTempK = stats.LST_Day_1km; // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (maxTempK === null || maxTempK === undefined) { console.log("Temperature calculation failed (null result)."); console.log("C3"); return; } const maxTempC = maxTempK - 273.15; // Validate temperature is in reasonable range if (maxTempC < -50 || maxTempC > 80) { console.log(`Invalid temperature: ${maxTempC.toFixed(2)}°C (out of range)`); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Max LST in Shanghai area: ${maxTempC.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Threshold: 39°C`); if (maxTempC > 39) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
